objective: Deliver a coherent, polished Lucent desktop, using Caelestia as the reference for complete interactions and visual quality.
implementation: Lucent Rust desktop and reusable UI toolkit
visual_direction: Develop Lucent's existing design tokens and visual identity while matching the reference's attention to interaction, motion and complete user workflows.

test_environment.runtime_source_status: Reviewed local candidate; separate from the published main checkpoint

required: Define the user-visible behavior and its error, empty, cancellation and recovery cases.
Put reusable interaction, layout, input and rendering support in the toolkit; retain desktop policy in the client and OS operations in adapters.
Exercise new toolkit contracts through an independent consumer when the contract is public.
Pass relevant behavior/protocol tests, formatting, strict Clippy and architecture checks.
Review real Vulkan output at relevant densities and sizes; preserve existing visual baselines unless a reviewed change is intentional.
Run actual mouse and keyboard workflows in the VM, verify the resulting application behavior, and restore temporary test state.
Record exact source/binary and test scope; keep implementation, VM acceptance, performance and protected-main delivery distinct.
Leave the VM usable for the user's own testing before moving to the next feature.

features.behavior: Ordinary controls acquire keyboard focus only after user intent, release it when their interaction ends, and do not steal it back from an application opened by mouse or keyboard.
features.toolkit: Prepared pointer-press observation, one-shot native focus requests, exact native lifetime events, focus-aware caret painting and bounded control commits.
completed_checks: Working branch reconciled with the exact d77 runtime already installed in the VM.
Formatting and strict workspace Clippy pass; 729 relevant Rust tests, 802 Python tests and 832 unchanged Vulkan visual cases pass.
Fresh pointer and Tab/Enter notification links each open a separate cold browser and deliver one trusted KeyA; nine restoration checks pass per route.
The independent bottom-layer focus client passes typing, Tab, Escape, reacquisition, foreground loss, explicit release, graceful quit/socket cleanup and desktop/cursor preservation.
Actual passive, focused and released native visuals reviewed.
Actual Notes completed-click typing, ordinary Undo, first same-workspace outside browser click/key, explicit Notes reacquisition and no browser key leak pass. All ten restoration/profile checks pass.
Two disjoint90-second read-only guest capture windows close with terminal receipts; each guest click precedes its KeyA. Actual focused/lost/reacquired caret visuals reviewed.
CI compatibility fix passes local strict workspace Clippy; actual source-bound native catalogue regenerated and validated:121 inputs,480 captures,9 stories.
remaining: Finish protected-main delivery through the existing keyboard-focus PR after current CI completes.

features.behavior: Search, keyboard selection, scrolling, section changes, launch/focus and dismissal form one consistent workflow.
features.toolkit: Controlled text, list layout/scrolling, stable identity and focus routing; add virtualization only where the actual workload requires it.

features.behavior: Bar controls switch panels in one click, with consistent focus, dismissal, loading, unavailable, retry and confirmation behavior.
features.toolkit: Reusable panel/popover focus scopes, controls and menu behavior driven by real client requirements.

features.behavior: Toasts and history have readable content, reachable actions, reliable DND and grouping, safe links and consistent keyboard navigation.
features.toolkit: Rich text, image preparation, scrolling, focus scopes and lifetimes.

features.behavior: Clipboard, emoji, command/menu and capture entry points feel integrated and preserve correct return-to-application behavior.
features.toolkit: Shared pickers, selection, clipboard transfers and any justified native popup/capture contracts.

features.behavior: Widgets, notes, calendar and media controls have complete editing, resizing, persistence, empty and error behavior.
features.toolkit: Controlled editors, sliders, pointer capture and reusable layout/input boundaries.

features.behavior: Palette and wallpaper browsing, previews, applying, cancellation and failures share consistent motion, spacing and density.
features.toolkit: Prepared assets, streaming textures, clipping, motion and cache ownership.

features.behavior: Display changes, per-output layouts, scaling and secure session transitions preserve usable controls and user state.
features.toolkit: Output/native lifetime contracts, density, input routing and secure role boundaries.

features.behavior: Verify cold/warm interaction cost and presentation, including resize/return-to-FHD memory, against the existing resource targets.
features.toolkit: Measured renderer/resource ownership and compositor pacing; keep resource checks part of each preceding feature as well.
